title: Materials tagged with alchemy
description: Materials with the [alchemy] tag can be converted into Gold in the presence of Draught of Midas. They would also be converted into Corrupted Rock if near existing Corrupted Rock, but that does not naturally appear in the publicly released version of the game.

title: Materials tagged with blood
description: Materials tagged with [blood] will be transmuted into Gold when a sufficient quantity is poured into the receptacle in The Hourglass Chamber.

title: Materials tagged with box2d
description: Materials tagged with [box2d] are used by the game for various rigid-body objects. This may have some meaning internal to the game engine, but the tag has no association with alchemical or spell-based effects that are currently known.

title: Materials tagged with earth
description: Materials with the [earth] tag can be converted into Soil with the Tannerkivi, and will be turned into Toxic Rock when a Giga Nuke explodes nearby.

title: Materials tagged with evaporable

title: Materials tagged with evaporable by fire

title: Materials tagged with evaporable custom
description: Materials with the [evaporable_custom] tag must always have a corresponding [material_name]_vapour material to evaporate into, and always react with lava or fire to form their corresponding vapour material.

title: Materials tagged with evaporable fast
description: Materials with the [evaporable_fast] tag will swiftly evaporate into nothingness (Air) on contact with air.

title: Materials tagged with fire
description: Materials with the [fire] tag tend to burn other flammable objects, evaporate liquids and other evaporable materials, and so on. Reactions involving [fire] tend to be quite rapid.
